params.caption: 🎮 Can GTA 6 justify an $80 price tag? An expert thinks so GTA 6 launches November 19 at a minimum of $80, which is $20 more than GTA 5 cost in 2013 and $10 above many current AAA releases. GameSpot asked an industry expert whether $80 is becoming the new standard, and the answer is that GTA 6 and a few other blockbusters can justify it. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 19:37 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 💰 Is $80 fair for GTA 6?
